what: Labels table for slice 1 (design section 3.2). Module classes with evidence; each output lists its module chain and takes the weakest class (design 3.3 rule 1). Reviewed with each new blind result.

class_meaning.P: probability: every module in the chain passed an unseen blind set (or preregistered transfer test) in this region
class_meaning.X: calibrated scenario: q95 coverage passed the simulator back-replay on an unseen set (none yet)
class_meaning.N: not confirmed: same-direction blind evidence that missed its alpha, or a pass with a calibration caveat
class_meaning.S: scenario: anything else ("in k of N simulated paths", "scenario tail (95th of N paths)")
